lines: <pulse>Back</pulse> to odd jobs before my ideas wander off without me.
I should go find a small task and make it look neat.
There is a strange little fix I wanted to try.
I have a list of silly-useful ideas, and one of them might work.
I promised to help someone carry something awkward today.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to sorting scraps into something useful.
Maybe I'll see if that squeaky hinge wants my opinion.
I am not much for plans, but I can still do the next thing.
I'll be by the crossroads if anything needs trying.
I'll come back once I have chased down another odd thought.
I should check whether the bucket is still where I forgot it.
That is enough talking for one corner. It needs quiet too.
I am off to do something small and possibly helpful.
The sun moved while we talked. I should probably move too.
I have to return a stick before somebody decides it is mine.
I will let you get back to your important walking.
There is a loose fence post waiting for the wrong kind of help. Mine might do.
I should go before my next thought becomes your problem.
See you later, unless I take the long way by accident.
Alright, goodbye. I remembered that part at exactly the right time.
